body.p: You can add comments to selected content in Markdown documents, reply to existing comments, edit your own comments, and remove comments. You can also manage all the comments of a document from the Review view. The comments are saved in the document as HTML comments, so the Markdown content itself remains unchanged. Each comment is attached to selected content and records the author's name and the time it was added. The author name is specified in the Review preferences page.

section.title: Adding a Comment
section.p:
To add a comment:
Select the content that you want to comment on. You can add a comment only to selected content.
Select the Add Comment action from the Markdown toolbar, from the contextual menu, or from the Document Markdown menu.
Type the comment in the dialog box that opens and click OK.

The commented content is highlighted, and a marker appears in the vertical stripe on the right side of the editor. Hover over the commented content or its marker to display the comment, its author, and the time it was added. Comments are rendered using the colors configured for comments in Author mode on the Review preferences page.

section.title: Replying to a Comment
section.p: To reply to a comment, place the cursor in the commented content, right-click, and select Add Reply from the contextual menu. Replies are displayed with the comment when you hover over the commented content.

section.title: Editing or Showing a Comment
section.p: To edit a comment, place the cursor in the commented content, right-click, and select Edit Comment from the contextual menu. Just like in Author mode, you can edit only the comments that you added, and only while they are not marked as done. Otherwise, the action is named Show Comment and it displays the comment without allowing you to change it. If you added a comment that already has replies, it is also only displayed, together with a button that allows you to reply to it. Editing a comment keeps the time when it was added.

section.title: Removing a Comment
section.p: To remove a comment, place the cursor in the commented content, right-click, and select Remove Comment from the contextual menu. The comment and all its replies are removed. If several comments have been added to the same content, the innermost comment is removed.
If you delete all the content to which a comment was added, the comment is also removed.
section.note: Adding, editing, and removing comments and replies, as well as marking comments as done, can be undone and redone, just like any other editing action.

section.title: Managing Comments in the Review View
section.p: The Review view presents all the comments of the current Markdown document, each comment followed by its replies, just like it does for the comments in Author mode. To open it, select the Manage reviews action from the Markdown toolbar, from the contextual menu, or from the Document Markdown menu.

The view and the editor are synchronized. When you select a comment in the view, the commented content is selected in the editor. When you place the cursor inside commented content, its comment is selected in the view.

The view offers the following features:
A filter field at the top of the view that displays only the comments that contain the typed text in their author name, comment text, or commented content. If any comment of a thread matches, the entire thread is displayed. Typing the author name between quotes (for example, "john") displays only the threads that contain comments by that exact author.
Previous and Next buttons that navigate through the comments.
A Settings menu that contains the Show review time option and the Sort by date submenu (Oldest to newest, Newest to oldest, No sorting). These settings are shared with the Review view in Author mode.
Double-clicking a comment or pressing Enter edits or shows it. Pressing Delete removes the selected comments.

The following actions are available in the contextual menu of the view:
Edit Comment / Show Comment Edits the selected comment or only displays it, following the same rules as in the editor.
Add Reply Adds a reply to the thread of the selected comment. Not available for comments marked as done.
Mark as Done Marks the comment thread (the comment and all its replies) as done, or as not done if it was already marked. Comments marked as done are displayed grayed out in the view and can no longer be edited.
Remove Comment(s) Removes the selected comments. Removing a comment also removes its replies, while removing a reply keeps the comment it replies to.
Remove all comments Removes all the comments from the document.
Show only reviews by '<author name>' Filters the view to display only the comment threads that contain comments by the author of the selected comment.

section.title: How Comments Are Saved
section.p: The comments are saved in the Markdown document as pairs of HTML comments placed around the commented content. For example:
section.codeblock: Some <!--oxy_comment_start author="john" timestamp="20260908T161113+0300" comment="Please review"-->commented<!--oxy_comment_end--> text.
section.p: The editor does not display these HTML comments. Instead, it displays highlights over the commented content. If a comment starts or ends at the beginning of a line, its HTML comment is saved on a separate line. A comment marked as done is saved with a flag="done" attribute, and a comment that has replies is saved with an id attribute, referenced by the parentID attribute of its replies.
The Preview pane renders the document as saved, including comments, and refreshes when you add or remove a comment.

section.title: Turning Off Comments
section.p: You can turn off comments by deselecting the Enable comments option on the Markdown preferences page. When comments are turned off, you cannot add comments, and HTML comments already in a document are displayed in the editor as regular content.
